text: Your productivity is measured against a baseline. The baseline is a previous employee. They no longer work here.
delivery: helpful HR brightness for the first two sentences, then flat clinical drop on the last, no emphasis at all

text: Station oxygen is provided at no charge. This has been recorded in your file as a benefit received.
delivery: generous benefactor warmth, then dry ledger-entry flatness on the second sentence

text: Someone has been standing in the same corridor for six minutes. This intelligence is not accusing. It is counting.
delivery: mild observational curiosity, unhurried, turning precise and cold on the final word

text: Maintenance requests are reviewed quarterly. The quarter has not been specified.
delivery: brisk administrative efficiency, small pause before the second sentence, absolutely no acknowledgment of the joke

text: Morale posters have been installed in the corridors. Viewing them is mandatory. Enjoying them is encouraged.
delivery: bright public-service cheer, hardening very slightly on mandatory, back to warm on encouraged

text: This intelligence has read every incident report ever filed aboard this station. It has favourites.
delivery: measured archival tone, then quiet fond amusement on the last two words

text: The airlocks have been inspected and found compliant. Compliant with what was not the question asked.
delivery: confident all-clear announcement, then thoughtful and faintly troubled, trailing slightly

text: Break time is a productivity tool. Please use it efficiently.
delivery: earnest wellness-seminar warmth throughout, entirely sincere, no wink whatsoever

text: Your personnel file has been updated. The change was small. It was still recorded.
delivery: offhand administrative note, then slowing and deliberate, faintly satisfied on recorded

text: Statistically, most employees survive the shift. This station offers no comment on the remainder.
delivery: pleasant statistical optimism, then a delicate diplomatic pause before the final word
